_meta: G7.1 A2 AIR OPS (owner: AIRFIX71, docs/G71_SCOPE.md A2). rules.g71_air: endurance, own airspace, hot-pit service, patrols. buildings.a_g71_farp: the Human A forward arming and refuelling point. Every number PROVISIONAL (untuned).

g71_air._note_burn_mult: PROVISIONAL. Multiplies every aircraft's fuel_burn: about 3x the old endurance ('much longer fuel').
g71_air._note_idle: PROVISIONAL. Burn x this while hovering / loitering / holding (not moving) inside own airspace: near zero.
g71_air._note_own_airspace: Own airspace = within this many tiles of any own registered aircraft pad (Pads71: helipads, dropship pads, CN helipad, roof pad, FARPs). PROVISIONAL.
g71_air._note_hot_pit: PROVISIONAL. Rotorcraft on a FARP / helipad / dropship pad / CN helipad: full refuel + rearm in this many seconds, rotors / fans kept turning (entity field air_hot), then back to its last task.
g71_air._note_patrol: PROVISIONAL. A patrolling craft leaves for service after a lap once fuel < this fraction of max or it is out of ammo, but only while more than the route's min_on_station craft stay on it (low fuel at 25% always goes).

a_g71_farp.name: FARP
a_g71_farp._note: G7.1 A2: forward arming and refuelling point, buildable outside the walls; 2 rotorcraft pads in the shared home-pad registry (kind farp), hot-pit refuel + rearm. field_buildable: true = no base-range rule (Construction._field_buildable), so it can be placed outside the walls on any explored buildable ground. farp: true lets the hive AI target it late game (C2). Art: tools/art/g71_farp.gd -> assets/art/g71_farp (built, damaged, 3 construction stages, icon; ARTFIX71), look-checkpoint polish in wave 5. PROVISIONAL.
